raw.translational: Understanding the shared mechanistic basis in carnitine transport and fatty acid oxidation can inform therapeutic strategies. For systemic carnitine deficiency, carnitine supplementation is a primary treatment. For carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase deficiency, while carnitine supplementation can be beneficial, the focus is often on managing energy deficits through frequent feeding and avoiding catabolic states. Shared understanding could lead to novel interventions targeting the common pathway of fatty acid oxidation impairment.
